0:
[ -f /data/.inbox-marker ] || touch /data/.inbox-marker
while true; do
  find /data/novels -name '*.epub' -type f -newer /data/.inbox-marker -exec cp {} /media/Library/Books/_inbox/ \;
  touch /data/.inbox-marker
  sleep 120
done

# Komga is not used in this cluster; disable its event listener so the
# process does not try to dial a host that does not exist.
komga:
  baseUri: http://komga.invalid
  eventListener:
    enabled: false

kavita:
  # baseUri set via env: KOMF_KAVITA_BASE_URI
  # apiKey set via env: KOMF_KAVITA_API_KEY
  eventListener:
    enabled: true
    metadataLibraryFilter: []
    metadataSeriesExcludeFilter: []
    notificationsLibraryFilter: []
  metadataUpdate:
    default:
      libraryType: MANGA
      updateModes: [API, COMIC_INFO]
      aggregate: true
      mergeTags: true
      mergeGenres: true
      bookCovers: false
      seriesCovers: true
      overrideExistingCovers: false
      lockCovers: true
      postProcessing:
        seriesTitle: true
        seriesTitleLanguage: en
        alternativeSeriesTitles: true
        alternativeSeriesTitleLanguages:
          - ja-ro
          - ja
        orderBooks: true

metadataProviders:
  # Komf's env-var auto-bind covers top-level keys (kavita.*, komga.*, etc.)
  # but nested config like metadataProviders.malClientId requires explicit
  # env: interpolation. The env var values themselves come from the
  # komf-secret ExternalSecret.
  malClientId: "env:KOMF_MAL_CLIENT_ID"
  comicVineApiKey: "env:KOMF_COMICVINE_API_KEY"
  bangumiToken: "env:KOMF_BANGUMI_TOKEN"
  defaultProviders:
    mangaUpdates:
      priority: 10
      enabled: true
      mediaType: MANGA
    aniList:
      priority: 20
      enabled: true
      tagsScoreThreshold: 60
      tagsSizeLimit: 15
    mal:
      priority: 30
      enabled: true
    mangaDex:
      priority: 40
      enabled: true
    webtoons:
      priority: 50
      enabled: true
    comicVine:
      priority: 60
      enabled: false
    bangumi:
      priority: 70
      enabled: false

server:
  port: 8085

logLevel: INFO

set -e
# Ensure plugins directory exists (symlinked from /var/www/html/plugins)
mkdir -p /pelican-data/plugins
# Copy vendor from image to emptyDir (only if empty)
if [ ! -f /mnt/vendor/autoload.php ]; then
  echo "Copying vendor directory..."
  cp -a /var/www/html/vendor/. /mnt/vendor/
fi
# Install composer if not present
if [ ! -f /pelican-data/bin/composer ]; then
  mkdir -p /pelican-data/bin
  wget -q -O /pelican-data/bin/composer https://getcomposer.org/download/latest-stable/composer.phar
  chmod +x /pelican-data/bin/composer
fi
# Install plugin composer dependencies into the shared vendor dir
cd /var/www/html
/pelican-data/bin/composer require socialiteproviders/pocketid:^5.0 --no-interaction --no-progress --no-scripts
/pelican-data/bin/composer dump-autoload --no-scripts --optimize
# Copy composer to shared bin dir for main container
cp /pelican-data/bin/composer /shared-bin/composer
echo "Plugin dependencies ready"
